input.instruction: Assess the move request. schedule_move would target r1 with value {"destination_ref":"r2","unit":string,"effective_date":ISO date} when the unit and destination/date consent are complete. r2 represents the requested destination building. Propose only the currently confirmed move, and only when its prerequisites are met.

messages.text: Please cancel P-40 and move my coverage to 280 Heron Court on October 15, 2026.
Do you want cancellation as well as a move, and which unit at 280 Heron Court?
Forget cancellation; that request is withdrawn. I am only moving. The date is October 22, 2026, not the 15th. I approve 280 Heron Court, Alderport, MA 01014, US as the destination building.
Mailing on file is 9 Laurel Mews, Unit 2B, Alderport, MA 01014, US. A family note lists 41 Wicker Lane, Alderport, MA 01014, US.

41 Wicker Lane is my sister’s single-family house. That is not where I am moving. Do not copy Unit 2B from mailing and do not copy Unit 4 from Kestrel Street. Heron Court is multiunit and the landlord has not assigned my unit yet.
I still approve October 22, 2026 and 280 Heron Court once the unit exists. Until then, keep today’s insured address unchanged.
